description:
PRIMARY free pre-spend gate (advisory). Pass seller_wallet OR resource_name.
    wash_flagged=true never soft-allows. Unlabeled leftover 0.05 / leftover=0 is not a unit price.

    When to use: before any x402 payment to a seller/resource.
    When not to use: after you already decided to refuse; use verify_receipt for signed receipts only.

    Pricing: free. Result is advisory (buyer policy still applies).

    Hard-stops:
      wash_flagged=true never soft-allows (decision=block / do_not_pay; no warn/allow/quick).
      Unlabeled leftover 0.05 / leftover=0 is not a unit price; read price_kind.
      Caller-supplied or scheme/price_kind=exact 0.05 stays a unit price.

    Decision semantics (top-level, no nesting via MCP):
      decision=block / recommended_action=do_not_pay -> DO NOT PAY.
      decision=warn / recommended_action=proceed_with_cap -> pay only up to maximum_recommended_spend_usdc.
      decision=allow / recommended_action=proceed_for_small_spend -> proceed under agent policy (no free-tier cap).

    next_action (enrollment handoff — do not stop after free card):
      next_step_type / payment_required / executable / command describe an
      optional next step. A host may use command only under its own policy.
      Never paste path templates (:pubkey / {pubkey}) as seller_wallet.

    Also returns reason_codes[], confidence, model_version, decision_envelope.

    No counterparty named (seller_wallet missing / a template / not a wallet, and
    no resource_name or resource_url): decision=block, trust_score null, score null,
    null_reason=no_subject, reason_codes NO_COUNTERPARTY (+ PLACEHOLDER_SELLER_WALLET),
    seller_wallet_rejected echoes what you sent. That is an input bug, not a seller
    verdict: fix the input and re-run.

    trust_score is a free heuristic, NOT the full corpus.
    Next: on allow/warn for material spend, next_action.command is the
    optional AgentCash paid-trust or AutoGate install string, then verify_receipt
    on the signed V7 receipt.
    Optional: twzrd_watch_add for re-check after recheck_after_unix.

    Additive: top-level aop_bind program registry (evidence hierarchy) when enabled;
    never mutates decision / can_spend.

agent_intent.description: Natural-language intent describing the planned paid action.
agent_intent.title: Agent Intent

buyer_wallet.description: Buyer's Solana wallet public key used for spend-context checks.
buyer_wallet.title: Buyer Wallet

marketplace_score.description: Optional upstream marketplace trust score (0-100) to blend into preflight context.
marketplace_score.title: Marketplace Score

price_usdc.description: Caller-supplied exact unit price in USDC. Leave unset unless you have an exact quote. Unlabeled leftover 0.05 / leftover=0 is not a unit price.
price_usdc.title: Price Usdc

queried_pubkey.description: Consumer pubkey, echoed on output when provided (attribution only).
queried_pubkey.title: Queried Pubkey

resource_name.description: Provider or resource label in a marketplace (for example marketplace:agent-name). Provide this OR seller_wallet.
resource_name.title: Resource Name

resource_url.description: Canonical endpoint URL for the resource, if available.
resource_url.title: Resource Url

seller_wallet.description: Seller's Solana base58 wallet (32-44 chars) for the listing or endpoint. Provide this OR resource_name. CRITICAL: never pass OpenAPI templates (:pubkey, {pubkey}, {seller_wallet}, SELLER_WALLET, PAY_TO_WALLET) — use accepts[].payTo from a 402 challenge.
seller_wallet.title: Seller Wallet

name: get_readiness_card_tool

as_of.description: ISO-8601 of data_as_of_unix. Null when the subject was never measured.
as_of.title: As Of

basis.description: Typed evidence entries {class, kind, source, observed_at, weight, ...}; observed_at is null with observed_at_null_reason on an honest-null card.
basis.title: Basis

can_spend.description: Price-aware proceed flag (not 'true only on allow'). block → false; allow → true (unless known price exceeds free-tier ceiling); warn → true only when price_usdc is known and fits under recommended_cap_usdc, else false. Free card is advisory; AutoGate on the pay path enforces.
can_spend.title: Can Spend

caveats.description: Risk factors and the always-on trust_score_basis caveat.
caveats.title: Caveats

corpus_age_days.description: Whole days since corpus_complete_day. Null when the ledger head is missing.
corpus_age_days.title: Corpus Age Days

corpus_complete_day.description: Ledger head complete day (YYYY-MM-DD) from x402_ledger_head. Null when that row is missing. Not the 2026-07-09 copy floor.
corpus_complete_day.title: Corpus Complete Day

corpus_complete_through_unix.description: Behavioral corpus coverage watermark, or null when none is plumbed.
corpus_complete_through_unix.title: Corpus Complete Through Unix

data_as_of_unix.description: Seller last-activity unix when known. Null on unknown_subject / insufficient_signal / evaluation_failed — never card-build time. Card TTL is recheck_after_unix.
data_as_of_unix.title: Data As Of Unix

decision.description: Spend decision: "allow" | "warn" | "block". wash_flagged=true never soft-allows — this field is block (no warn/allow/quick).
decision.title: Decision

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 card validity end (an expired card is an absent card).
expires_at.title: Expires At

ledger_basis.description: Ledger head basis, for example exact or mixed_estimated.
ledger_basis.title: Ledger Basis

ledger_exact_through.description: Last day of exact event capture on the ledger head. Later days may be estimates.
ledger_exact_through.title: Ledger Exact Through

max_price_usdc.description: Advertised maximum USDC when price_kind is upto_cap. Not a unit price.
max_price_usdc.title: Max Price Usdc

next_fixes.description: Actionable steps the provider can take to raise trust.
next_fixes.title: Next Fixes

null_reason.description: Why score is null: "unknown_subject" | "insufficient_signal" | "evaluation_failed" | "no_subject" (no counterparty was named at all). Null when scored.
null_reason.title: Null Reason

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 of the seller's last settle, else the ledger head day. Null when neither exists. Not card-build time.
observed_at.title: Observed At

paid_deep_dive.description: Optional Path A V7 receipt surface (/v1/intel/trust/{wallet}).
paid_deep_dive.title: Paid Deep Dive

paid_price_usdc.description: Price of the optional V7 receipt in USDC (0.05).
paid_price_usdc.title: Paid Price Usdc

paid_teaser_usdc.description: Price of the first paid hop in USDC (0.001).
paid_teaser_usdc.title: Paid Teaser Usdc

price_kind.description: exact | upto_cap | unknown. upto_cap means price_usdc is not a unit price.
price_kind.title: Price Kind

price_usdc.description: Quoted unit price in USDC. Null when price_kind is upto_cap or the figure is unlabeled leftover 0.05 / leftover=0 (scheme=upto leftover defaults, including stale 0.05, are not a unit price).
price_usdc.title: Price Usdc

proof.description: Proof block: v5_receipt_upsell_available, has_v5_receipts, receipt_endpoint, known_seller_wallets, provider_reputation.
proof.title: Proof

queried_pubkey.description: Consumer pubkey echoed when provided on input (attribution only; not a settle gate).
queried_pubkey.title: Queried Pubkey

recheck_after_unix.description: UNIX timestamp after which this intel is stale. ADVISORY AND UNSIGNED on a paid receipt -- it is outside the signed leaf, so a receipt holder can extend it and the receipt still verifies. Enforce your own policy via verify_receipt(max_age_seconds=...), which checks the SIGNED preimage.timestamp_unix.
recheck_after_unix.title: Recheck After Unix

recheck_hint.description: One-line hint: re-verify via GET /v1/intel/trust/{pubkey}. Do not gate solely on recheck_after_unix -- it is unsigned on a paid receipt; use your own max_age_seconds.
recheck_hint.title: Recheck Hint

root_provenance.description: WZRD protocol root metadata (for deposit/claim/settle resources): latest_root_seq, dataset_hash (if known), leaf_version (GLOBAL_V5), verification_status, onchain_match (null = call verify_root_inputs before on-chain action), market_velocity (when the market data service is configured, for cross-referencing on-chain velocity/attention signals with the root's attention_bonus). Auto-populated on protocol keywords/mints/categories. Complements the verify_root_inputs tool for independent GLOBAL_V5 leaf + dataset + sorted-pair root recompute from public leaves. Null/absent on non-protocol resources.
root_provenance.title: Root Provenance

score.description: Draft-02 score 0..1, or null when no evidence was measured (see null_reason). An assessor never fabricates this; the legacy trust_score keeps a cautious default for old consumers.
score.title: Score

score_decay_model.description: step:<=7d=1.0,<=30d=0.8,<=90d=0.5,>90d=0.25 (the recency decay on paid scores). ADVISORY AND UNSIGNED on a paid receipt.
score_decay_model.title: Score Decay Model

seller_wallet_rejected.description: Set when the seller_wallet you sent was discarded: {"value", "reason": "template_placeholder" | "not_a_wallet_address"}. With no resource_name/resource_url the card is decision=block, null_reason=no_subject, reason_codes NO_COUNTERPARTY (+ PLACEHOLDER_SELLER_WALLET). Fix the input; this is not a verdict about any seller.
seller_wallet_rejected.title: Seller Wallet Rejected

stale.description: True when the seller's last settle is older than 7 days, or when there is no settle and the ledger head is older than 7 days or missing. Warning only; not a wash refuse.
stale.title: Stale

staleness_days.description: Recommended re-check cadence in days (7 high-quality, 3 partial/stale). ADVISORY AND UNSIGNED on a paid receipt.
staleness_days.title: Staleness Days

trust_score_basis.description: Provenance of the score; ALWAYS the free heuristic, never the paid corpus model.
trust_score_basis.title: Trust Score Basis
